reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing media interaction extension: the manifest and README show it is a DSH web plugin that adds a Live Talk conversation panel with animated virtual character playback and provider-based ASR/TTS/avatar-media support, so it fits best under media tools rather than development or orchestration tooling.

summaries.zh: Live Talk 是一款 DSH 的 Web 插件，可在会话界面中展示并驱动虚拟角色，通过语音/文本能力与角色进行动画化交互。
summaries.en: Live Talk is a DSH web plugin that displays and drives a virtual character in the conversation view while connecting media and speech capabilities for interactive dialogue.

capabilities: Installs as a DSH plugin with a web conversation UI surface for displaying animated characters
Provides ASR/TTS/avatar-media provider integration and runtime seams for pluggable speech/media backends
Processes conversation-related media (audio/video) with character state/emotion handling for animated responses

reasons.code: package.json defines the DSH bundle/client manifest and web client entry points, showing runtime integration into host UI and packaging as an installed plugin.
README describes a Live Talk conversation panel, character rendering, emotion/image/video assets, and registered providers for ASR/TTS/avatar-media including browser fallbacks.

Source structure and manifest-related files indicate provider seams and media pipeline modules (e.g., provider registry and conversation/character modules), which implies external service/media processing behavior.
README notes credentials are supplied via dsh ctx.credentials or local proxy for providers, introducing runtime external service interaction and sensitive-config handling.
